hooks.command: npx tsc --noEmit 1>&2 || echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "TypeScript check failed — fix errors before pushing. Run: npx tsc --noEmit"}'

command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
prs=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,title,statusCheckRollup 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
printf '%s' "$prs" | jq '[ .[] | select(any(.statusCheckRollup[]?; ((.conclusion // .state // "") | ascii_upcase) as $c | ($c=="FAILURE" or $c=="ERROR" or $c=="TIMED_OUT" or $c=="CANCELLED" or $c=="ACTION_REQUIRED" or $c=="STARTUP_FAILURE"))) | "#\(.number) \(.title)" ] | if length==0 then empty else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart", additionalContext:("⚠️ Open PRs with FAILING CI checks (mention these to the user at the start of your reply):\n" + join("\n"))}} end' 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for PRs with failing CI...
